This leaf is found chiefly in hot and humid climates, especially in freshwater banks and shores.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains fairly easy to find.

To obtain its properties, it is prepared as a paste.

Level 3B muscle poison. This tan paste attacks hearing, inflicts 1–10 concussion hits, and can ultimately destroy the victim’s hearing.
